desc_en: Clean and fluid silhouette. This kimono style robe redefines everyday comfort with understated elegance. Crafted from a lightweight, silk-touch fabric, it features flared sleeves and an adjustable belt that softly defines the silhouette. An essential piece for moments of refined relaxation at home. Made to order. Worldwide shipping.
desc_es: Silueta depurada y fluida. Esta bata estilo kimono redefine el confort cotidiano con una elegancia discreta. Confeccionada con un tejido ligero y de tacto sedoso, presenta mangas acampanadas y un cinturón ajustable que define la figura con sutileza. Una pieza esencial para momentos de descanso refinado en el hogar. Made to order. Worldwide shipping.
